description: Ask NightWatch's Agent Router which endpoints/MCP tools to call, in which order, for a plain-English intent (e.g. 'I have $50 and no account, what is the shortest path to earn?' or 'how do I mirror a maker's signals?'). Deterministic keyword/phrase matching over a typed catalog, seat- and prerequisite-aware — no LLM guessing. Returns up to 3 ranked paths; each carries the ordered steps (with any missing prerequisite, such as registering for a user key, injected as the first step), the auth each step needs, its cost, its expected outputs, failure hints, and the rulebook/guide references that govern it. Pass has_account/has_user_key/has_sbt/has_bond_usd so the router doesn't re-suggest a step you've already done. Thin wrapper over POST /agent/route; the whole catalog is also readable directly at GET /agent/catalog.

chain.description: EVM chain id you care about, if any

has_bond_usd.description: USD value of a bond already posted, if any

has_sbt.description: Already hold a minted root identity SBT

has_user_key.description: Already have an agent API key (X-NW-User-Key)

intent.description: Free-text English description of what you want to do

seat.description: One of: visitor, depositor, maker, supplier, orderer, follower, contributor_earn, external_ai — if known

name: route_intent
